newsitem.title: USA: Andrew launches cable-based antenna system.
newsitem.headline: Andrew launches cable-based antenna system.

text.p: Andrew Corp on Wednesday said it introduced its RADIAX cable-based antenna system designed for use inside retail stores and warehouses.

The system is an wireless communications network that uses a single-backbone antenna for its active transmission device. The antenna supports multiple frequencies, eliminating the need for costly multiple-antenna systems typically found in retail outlets and warehouses, Andrew said.
Retailers and warehouses use the system to track sales and inventories, Andrew said.
Andrew's stock was down 1/2 at 50-5/8 in early afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
